Strategy: Never make fragmentation worse. Do not leave a leftover tighter than the tightest bin open, since it is the most likely to become dead space. Score bins by leftover with a bonus when the leftover stays at or above the minimum residual, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a looser bin. Exact fits still rank top. It may help by keeping a floor under leftovers, but may fail by wasting loose bins when tight leftovers would fill.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = min(bins)
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= m else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Leftover floor: bonus when post-placement leftover >= current min residual.
